admission.justification: A fabricated closed file could replace the durable judgments supposedly made by its named owner.

applicability: Newly closed history files at converted master-level landings.
conditions: Every file not held closed by a base has an admitted publication owner and exact publication bytes.
exclusions: With no new history, owner enclosure/journal reads are unnecessary.
statement: Every newly-closed history file at a master landing names an accounted owner (landed leaf, recorded direct landing, admitted crossing sync) and matches its publication byte-identically.
